boundary: Browser-local hint-branch return persistence bridge only. Branches from avatar hints can persist, decay, burden residents, be forgotten, or be revived across return sessions. The avatar cannot reset history, force adoption, or install a uniform unlock. No LLM call, no subjective-consciousness claim, no moral-patienthood claim, no real civilization claim, no full physics claim, and no new research branch beyond the emergent-practice/game-foundation arc.
